title: Yummy Chewy Canadian Oats Bake
description: A flexitarian-friendly, fermented, and chewy Canadian dish featuring oats, perfect for midnight cravings. This recipe combines the richness of deglaze-fond with the comfort of oats.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine oats and water, then let it sit at room temperature for 8 hours or overnight to ferment.
In a small bowl, whisk together honey, yeast, and salt.
Add the honey mixture to the oat mixture and stir until combined.
Add unsalted butter, apple cider vinegar, and deglaze-fond to the oat mixture and stir until a sticky dough forms.
Transfer the dough to a 9x9 inch baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Cut into squares and serve warm.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
